_README: This is the control panel for the daily Meta Ads automation. Fill in every value marked TODO. All money values are in INR (whole rupees unless noted). The daily agent reads THIS file first, every run.

campaign._note: New daily ads are created INSIDE the target ad sets, so they share each ad set's existing ~500 INR/day budget and inherit its targeting. The agent does not add budget without approval.

daily_new_ad.message:
Ek wedding photographer ne mujhse poochha — "Abdullah bhai, main har weekend shoot karta hoon, phir bhi month end pe paisa nahi bachta. Kyun?"

Kyunki photography seekhna aur photography business banana — dono bilkul alag cheezein hain.

Pehli baar {city} mein ek physical workshop aa rahi hai, specifically wedding photographers ke liye. Seats limited hain.

👉 Call/WhatsApp: 8210515506
daily_new_ad.headline: Wedding Photography se 1 Crore — possible hai, agar sahi plan ho

leads_source._note: Leads carry Meta IDs via UTM tags, so the agent counts leads per ad set (UTM Term) and per ad (UTM Content), and only for our campaign (UTM Campaign = 120249797872700412). Timestamp is UTC (Z) and is shifted to Asia/Kolkata before bucketing by day.

creatives._note: CITY-LOCKED: a Lucknow ad set may ONLY use images from the Lucknow folder; Chandigarh ONLY from the Chandigarh folder. Never cross them. Each ad set's creatives_folder_id (in campaign.target_ad_sets) is authoritative.

approval.approval_wait: The agent stops after sending the proposal. It only creates/changes ads on the next run (or an immediate reply) where you have written APPROVE.
